slice: M2.1 - Blackthorne rumor layer: six rumors grounded in GAME_BIBLE days 1-3 (C1-C2 scope)
notes: Gossip zones follow NPC_SIMULATION 5 (bakehouse/market square, inn kitchen and public room, church porch, the burying ground). RUM-SHONI-HILL is the player leak tool's counter-rumor: it enters the village only through the leak, never from data seeds.

rumors.subject: HUNGER
variants: Three funerals in a month. The Hunger walks again, so the old people say.
The Hunger walks - and it was the sin-eater's bread that kept it fed, mind.
Y Newyn came back the day they buried Josias Vale. You can write that down.

rumors.subject: HUNGER
variants: Forty guineas the village paid Josias Vale to swallow Blackthorne's sins whole.
Forty guineas for the silence, and the Quiet Guinea families still count their dead.
They bought the village's quiet once. Quiet's what came back for it.

rumors.subject: HUNGER
variants: Tobias Nott is dead in his own mill, mouth packed with salt.
Salt in Nott's mouth, they say - the miller who thieved the weights.
The Hunger took Nott for the orphan's flour. Ate the sin out of him.

rumors.subject: EDMUND
variants: The sin-eater's son comes home after seventeen years, and the dead won't stay down.
It's the Vale lad. Bad blood came back to Blackthorne with him.
Mark me - the Hunger followed the son like it followed the father.

rumors.subject: SHONI
variants: The county constable wants Shoni Gwyn for the salt-death. The tinker, of all people.
Pritchard says the tinker did it. Pritchard arrived this morning and says so.
Shoni Gwyn will swing for Nott unless somebody speaks for him.

rumors.subject: SHONI
variants: Somebody says Shoni was up on the moor road that night - two miles from the mill.
There's talk the tinker's lantern was seen on the hill, not at the mill.
A voice at the well says the tinker never came down to the mill at all.
